narrative_passages.title: The three who were left behind

summary_for_children: At-Tawbah is about turning back to Allah, keeping our word, and being sincere. It mentions the cave where the Prophet and his companion sheltered.
environment_concept: A small empty cave in the hills (9:40), a simple mosque on firm foundations (9:108-109) and a circle of stones for learning (9:122).
architecture_and_scenery: Long desert road, rocky hills with a cave, a simple mosque with palm trunks and a learning circle.

areas.name: Cave of Two
areas.description: A small cave in the hills, empty and still.

areas.name: Mosque of Righteousness
areas.description: A simple mosque on firm foundations.

areas.name: Circle of Learning
areas.description: Stones in a circle where knowledge is shared.

narration_plan: The narrator explains the history carefully as explanation, and no person is shown in the cave.

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (cave, mosque, stones) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

adventure_world.title: The Journey of Return
adventure_world.source: "Quran Adventure: First 10 Unique Worlds" with the rule "114 unique game experiences" (2026-11-04); replaces the first adventure version built from the earlier design table
adventure_world.status: second version built for the web: each world now has its own core mechanic; draft, unreviewed; checked in headless Chromium with software WebGL only, not on phones or real GPUs
adventure_world.note: The new-look adventure world for this surah. It is a separate design from the composed scene this record describes; both are kept until reviewers choose.
adventure_world.core_play: A choices-and-reflection journey: answer everyday situations at signposts (an excuse sends you back a little way to think again), then walk through a gorge where the mist closes in and clears.

unique_world.visual_theme: Mountain gorge in mist that clears

primary_mechanic.text: Everyday choices where a wrong answer walks you back to think again, then a gorge whose mist thickens and clears as you go on (9:118).

unique_world.learning_objective: Turning back to Allah and being truthful
